input: CREATE TABLE t (id NUMBER(12,0), v NUMBER(10,2), n NUMBER, name VARCHAR2(20), d DATE, c CLOB, b BLOB);
sql: CREATE TABLE t (id NUMERIC(12,0), v NUMERIC(10,2), n NUMERIC, name VARCHAR(20), d TIMESTAMP, c TEXT, b BYTEA);

input: SELECT SYSDATE, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSDATE - 1 FROM DUAL;
sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('second', STATEMENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS TIMESTAMP), STATEMENT_TIMESTAMP(), CAST(DATE_TRUNC('second', STATEMENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '1 day';

input: SELECT NVL(col, 'x'), NVL(amount, 0), NVL2(flag, 'Y', 'N') FROM t;
sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(col, ''), 'x'), COALESCE(amount, 0), (CASE WHEN NULLIF(flag, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) FROM t;

input: SELECT DECODE(status, NULL, 'missing', 'A', 'active', 'other') FROM t;
sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN status = 'A' THEN 'active' ELSE 'other' END) FROM t;

input: SELECT TO_NUMBER(amount_txt), TO_NUMBER(TRIM(amount_txt)), TO_NUMBER('12.34') FROM t;
sql: SELECT CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(amount_txt AS TEXT), '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?(nan|inf(inity)?)[[:space:]]*$', '!', 'i'), '') AS NUMERIC), CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(amount_txt), '') AS TEXT), '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?(nan|inf(inity)?)[[:space:]]*$', '!', 'i'), '') AS NUMERIC), CAST(NULLIF(CAST('12.34' AS TEXT), '') AS NUMERIC) FROM t;

input: SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at), TO_CHAR(amount), TO_CHAR(created_at, 'RR-MM-DD') FROM t;
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_CHAR(amount, 'FM999999999'), TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YY-MM-DD') FROM t;

input: SELECT TO_DATE(date_txt), TO_DATE('2024-06-15'), TO_DATE('50-01-01', 'RR-MM-DD') FROM t;
sql: SELECT TO_DATE(NULLIF(date_txt, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE('2024-06-15', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), MAKE_TIMESTAMP((((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::integer / 100) + (CASE WHEN MOD(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::integer, 100) < 50 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 + 50), 1, 1, 0, 0, 0) FROM t;

input: SELECT TRUNC(amount), TRUNC(created_at, 'MM'), ADD_MONTHS(d, 1), MONTHS_BETWEEN(d1,d2), LAST_DAY(d), INSTR(code,'-') FROM t;
sql: SELECT TRUNC(amount), TRUNC(created_at, 'MM'), ADD_MONTHS(d, 1), MONTHS_BETWEEN(d1,d2), LAST_DAY(d), INSTR(code, '-') FROM t;

input: SELECT SUBSTR(code, 0, 3), SUBSTR(code, -2), SUBSTR(code, -3, 2), LPAD(12, 4, 0) FROM t;
sql: SELECT NULLIF(SUBSTR(CAST(code AS TEXT), 1, 3), ''), (SELECT CASE WHEN "__oc_0" IS NULL OR "__oc_1" IS NULL OR "__oc_1" > CHAR_LENGTH("__oc_0") OR "__oc_1" < -CHAR_LENGTH("__oc_0") THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(SUBSTR("__oc_0", CAST(CASE WHEN "__oc_1" = 0 THEN 1 WHEN "__oc_1" < 0 THEN CHAR_LENGTH("__oc_0") + "__oc_1" + 1 ELSE "__oc_1" END AS INTEGER)), '') END FROM (SELECT NULLIF(CAST(code AS TEXT), '') AS "__oc_0", TRUNC(CAST(-2 AS NUMERIC)) AS "__oc_1" OFFSET 0) AS "__oc_values"), (SELECT CASE WHEN "__oc_0" IS NULL OR "__oc_1" IS NULL OR "__oc_1" > CHAR_LENGTH("__oc_0") OR "__oc_1" < -CHAR_LENGTH("__oc_0") OR "__oc_2" IS NULL OR "__oc_2" < 1 THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(SUBSTR("__oc_0", CAST(CASE WHEN "__oc_1" = 0 THEN 1 WHEN "__oc_1" < 0 THEN CHAR_LENGTH("__oc_0") + "__oc_1" + 1 ELSE "__oc_1" END AS INTEGER), CAST(LEAST("__oc_2", CHAR_LENGTH("__oc_0")) AS INTEGER)), '') END FROM (SELECT NULLIF(CAST(code AS TEXT), '') AS "__oc_0", TRUNC(CAST(-3 AS NUMERIC)) AS "__oc_1", TRUNC(CAST(2 AS NUMERIC)) AS "__oc_2" OFFSET 0) AS "__oc_values"), LPAD(CAST(12 AS TEXT), 4, '0') FROM t;

input: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name FROM t;
sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name FROM t;

input: SELECT * FROM t WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ORDER BY id;
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM t LIMIT 10) AS t ORDER BY id;

input: SELECT * FROM t WHERE active = 1 AND ROWNUM <= 10 AND deleted = 0;
sql:
SELECT * FROM t WHERE active = 1 AND deleted = 0
LIMIT 10;

input: SELECT MYSEQ.NEXTVAL, MYSEQ.CURRVAL FROM DUAL;
sql: SELECT nextval('myseq'), currval('myseq');

input: UPDATE TEST A SET A.X = B, TEST.Y = 2 WHERE A.ID = B.ID;
sql: UPDATE TEST A SET X = B, Y = 2 WHERE A.ID = B.ID;

input: MERGE INTO tgt t USING src s ON (t.id=s.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.name=s.name WHERE s.active=1;
sql: MERGE INTO tgt t USING src s ON (t.id=s.id) WHEN MATCHED AND (s.active=1) THEN UPDATE SET name=s.name;
